title: Virtualization-Based Credential Guard (LSA Isolated User Mode) is Disabled
description: Windows Defender Credential Guard isolates NTLM password hashes and Kerberos Ticket Granting Tickets (TGTs) in a virtualized container (VBS Isolated User Mode), shielding them even from administrative code execution.
impact: If an attacker achieves local SYSTEM or administrator privileges, they can dump credentials directly from LSASS memory using Mimikatz or procdump.
remediation_guidance: Enable Credential Guard via Group Policy: Computer Configuration > Administrative Templates > System > Device Guard > Turn On Virtualization Based Security > Credential Guard Configuration.
